data.body:
Orchestrator close — acceptance criteria ticked on the implementing agent's REPORTED per-AC
evidence, and the change is merged to `origin/main`.

What I verified myself before ticking:
- the merge commit exists on `origin/main` and carries this ticket's `rebar-ticket:` trailer;
- the commit is reachable from a throwaway worktree checked out at `origin/main`, which is where
  this close is being run (the shared main checkout holds another session's uncommitted work, so
  it was deliberately not fast-forwarded);
- both Gerrit gates were green on the submitted patchset (`LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`).

What I did NOT independently re-run: the per-AC commands. Those were executed and their output
pasted by the implementing agent, and CI re-ran the full suite on the patchset. Recording the
distinction so the trail says which evidence is first-hand and which is relayed — the completion
verifier gate is the independent check on the criteria themselves.
